title: Training speech deepfake detectors against worst-case filters: Gains, Costs and Limits
abstract: arXiv:2611.28718v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech deepfake detectors make few errors on standard benchmarks, yet a simple attack defeats them: the attacker passes fake speech through one short filter, tuned against the detector, and many fakes then pass as real. Training with random filters does not stop this attack, because the attacker uses the worst filter, not a random one.   We therefore train the detector against the worst case: during training, a small set of filters is updated to fool the current detector, at about the cost of random filters. In a preregistered study, this made the detector more robust to filter attacks on real-world recordings than random filters did. It also lowered the in-domain attack error of the standard detector, and beat one-step adversarial training with additive noise on real-world recordings. translated_title: 训练语音深度伪造检测器对抗最坏情况滤波器：收益、成本与限制
translated_abstract: 语音深度伪造检测器在标准基准测试上错误很少，然而一个简单的攻击就能击败它们：攻击者将伪造语音通过一个针对检测器调谐的短滤波器，许多伪造语音随后便能以假乱真。使用随机滤波器进行训练无法阻止这种攻击，因为攻击者使用的是最坏情况的滤波器，而非随机滤波器。因此，我们针对最坏情况来训练检测器：在训练过程中，更新一小组滤波器以欺骗当前检测器，其成本约与使用随机滤波器相当。在一项预注册研究中，与随机滤波器相比，这种方法使检测器对真实世界录音上的滤波器攻击更加鲁棒。它还降低了标准检测器的域内攻击错误率，并在真实世界录音上优于使用加性噪声的一步对抗训练。其代价是检测器在未滤波语音上的错误率更高，且一项验证研究表明，在留出的欺骗系统上选择检查点使标准……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出针对最坏情况滤波器训练语音深度伪造检测器，显著提升其对滤波器攻击的鲁棒性且训练成本较低，但代价是检测器在未滤波语音上的错误率有所升高。
en_tdlr: Training speech deepfake detectors against worst-case filters substantially improves robustness to filter attacks at low training cost, but comes with the trade-off of higher errors on unfiltered speech.
